name: shopee_br-mcp
description: Shopee Brasil (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders, mark_shipped, set_inventory, update_listing, en

platform_mcp_shopee_br_partner_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_BR_PARTNER_KEY
platform_mcp_shopee_br_partner_key.description: partner_key (live key) of the app; signs the token refresh and every shop call (HMAC-SHA256). Never sent on the wire.

platform_mcp_shopee_br_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_BR_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_shopee_br_refresh_token.description: refresh_token from GetAccessToken (/api/v2/auth/token/get) after the shop authorised the app (https://open.shopee.com/developer-guide/20). Valid 30 days and rotated on every refresh; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR so the newest one survives restarts.

platform_mcp_shopee_br_partner_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_BR_PARTNER_ID
platform_mcp_shopee_br_partner_id.description: partner_id of your Shopee Open Platform app (Console > App).

platform_mcp_shopee_br_shop_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_BR_SHOP_ID
platform_mcp_shopee_br_shop_id.description: shop_id of the authorised shop (returned in the authorisation redirect).

tools.name: me
tools.description: v2.shop.get_shop_info: shop_name, region, status and the authorisation expire_time.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: v2.order.get_order_list: orders created from `since` (required; the window up to now may be at most 15 days) newest pages via next_cursor. `status`: UNPAID, READY_TO_SHIP, PROCESSED, SHIPPED, COMPLETED, IN_CANCEL, CANCELLED, INVOICE_PENDING. Amounts and items: v2.order.get_order_detail (not mapped).

tools.name: mark_shipped
tools.description: v2.logistics.ship_order for NON-INTEGRATED logistics channels: ships order `order_id` with the carrier's `tracking_number` (non_integrated.tracking_number). Integrated channels need pickup/dropoff details from v2.logistics.get_shipping_parameter and are not mapped; `carrier` is not sent.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: v2.product.update_stock: sets the seller stock of item `listing_id`; `sku` is the model_id (0 for an item without variations). Check `failures` (failure_list with failed_reason).

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: v2.product.update_price: sets the original price of item `listing_id` without variations (model_id 0) in the shop's local currency. Items with models need per-model prices (not mapped); title/description edits (v2.product.update_item) are not mapped.
